bills.title: Social Security and Other Legislation Amendment (Supporting the Transition to Work) Bill 2023

name: The majority voted against [Greens Party amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-11-17.199.1) on [sheet 2154](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr7099_amend_e7dbcb19-4456-4037-90d4-ef9cc1345645%22;rec=0) and [sheet 2155](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr7099_amend_d3d45e99-65ac-42f4-b1e8-a318bbdca993%22;rec=0), which means they failed. ### What do the amendments do? The amendments would have introduced a number of changes into the bill, including an increase to the income free areas for certain payments. Read the text of the amendments for more.
